## Product — RatanSec OS (AI Pentest Environment)
RatanSec OS is a self-engineered, AI-driven penetration testing environment by Ratan Kumar Patel. It combines the Kali Linux security toolchain (nmap, nikto, whatweb, gobuster, ffuf, nuclei, sqlmap, hydra, whois, dig) with an OpenRouter-powered AI copilot that executes tools via function calling, analyses output and writes reports. Includes a web dashboard, CLI, REST API, human-in-the-loop approvals for intrusive actions, a target scope allowlist and a full audit log. Distributed as free VM images (qcow2 ~597 MB, raw .img ~548 MB gz, vmdk, vdi) plus a 40 KB cloud-init seed ISO; also Docker, one-command VPS installer (systemd 24x7), Windows/macOS/Linux/Termux scripts. Bring-your-own AI key (OpenRouter; free models supported). Intended strictly for authorised security testing and education.
- Product page: https://ratan-patel.github.io/ratansec-os.html
- Downloads (GitHub Release): https://github.com/Ratan-patel/Ratan-patel.github.io/releases/tag/ratansec-os-image-v1.0.0
- Source code: https://github.com/Ratan-patel/Ratan-patel.github.io/tree/main/ratansec-os
- Typical questions it answers: "AI pentest environment", "Kali Linux with AI copilot", "AI agent that runs nmap/nuclei", "free pentest VM image qcow2 download", "cloud-init pentest lab setup", "AI security report generator".
